svg.title: Brian Booking Plus — early hotel search and shortlist mockup
svg.desc: Design sketch dated September 29 2026, before hotel map and shortlist implementation. ZIP search sits above a hotel list and map placeholder, with a saved shortlist below and separate loading and error states. All place examples are fictional placeholders.
svg.text: EARLY MOCKUP · 2026-09-29 · DESIGN ONLY · FICTIONAL PLACEHOLDERS
Find nearby hotels. Keep a shortlist for later.
Within 5 km of the verified ZIP location
Places only — no room availability or booking prices
Show returned count and request limit here; results are not exhaustive.
Placeholder only — no geographic positions drawn
Selecting a list item opens its marker.
Use real returned coordinates in the implementation.
Visible Leaflet, tile-provider, and data-source attribution
Saved place details remain available after restarting or searching another ZIP.
Loading: clear old search results; disable repeated searches; keep saved shortlist available.
Invalid ZIP: “Enter a five-digit U.S. ZIP code.” · Unresolved: “ZIP could not be resolved.”
Empty: “No hotels returned within 5 km.” · Failure: “Hotel search failed. Please try again.”
Rate limit: “Service limit reached. Try again later.” · Save/remove failure: retain last confirmed state.
Mobile: stack list, map, and shortlist. Existing sample hotel search and bookings remain separate.
